fileheader.author: FlightBox
fileheader.description: MiG-29 9-12 Fulcrum-A — FlightBox's own model, built to doc/mig29/flight-model-spec.md
fileheader.note: INVERTED FROM PUBLISHED ENVELOPE DATA, NOT MEASURED. No MiG-29 aerodynamic dataset is public at any confidence tier. The geometry, masses, engine statics and the flight envelope are documented; every aerodynamic coefficient here is inverted from an envelope anchor, computed from geometry, taken by the DECLARED F/A-18 HARV analogy (NASA TM-110216) for the high-alpha regime, or is a declared FlightBox setting. Each number says which, next to itself. This is not a wind-tunnel deck and must not be presented as one. release=ALPHA until the spec §8 anchor table passes.
